summary: Completed full e2e testing of Stripe Checkout integration for Tubiate $99 Lifetime Deal. All 18 backend API tests passed. Frontend tests verified the complete checkout flow: Pricing page displays correctly, Buy button redirects to Stripe checkout, CheckoutSuccess page polls for payment status and handles success/failure states appropriately.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login returns has_paid field in user object
POST /api/auth/register returns has_paid=False for new users
GET /api/auth/me returns has_paid field
POST /api/checkout/create-session requires authentication (returns 401/403 without token)
POST /api/checkout/create-session creates Stripe checkout session with url and session_id
POST /api/checkout/create-session creates payment_transactions record in DB
GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} requires authentication
GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} returns 404 for non-existent session
GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} only allows session owner to check status
GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} returns correct response structure (status, payment_status)
POST /api/webhook/stripe endpoint exists and responds
Pricing page loads with $99 LIFETIME DEAL card
Pricing page shows all 12 included features
Buy button shows 'Get Lifetime Access' when not logged in
Buy button redirects to /signup when clicked without auth
Buy button triggers checkout session creation when logged in
Successful redirect to Stripe checkout page (https://checkout.stripe.com)
Stripe checkout shows correct amount: US$99.00
CheckoutSuccess page shows 'Confirming your payment...' state during polling
CheckoutSuccess page shows 'Payment status unclear' after max poll attempts for invalid session
CheckoutSuccess page has 'Go to Dashboard' button in failed state
Landing page still works
Login page still works
Signup page still works
Dashboard still works (protected route)
Terms page still works
Privacy page still works
Existing API endpoints still work: /api/, /api/quota/usage, /api/shortlist, /api/search-history, /api/search-reports
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe Checkout integration fully tested and working. Key flows verified: (1) Create checkout session returns valid Stripe URL + session_id, (2) Payment transactions are recorded in DB, (3) Status endpoint properly validates session ownership and returns payment_status, (4) Webhook endpoint exists and responds, (5) Frontend Pricing page correctly triggers checkout, (6) Frontend CheckoutSuccess page properly polls and displays success/failure states. The emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout library is used for Stripe integration. Note: We cannot complete an actual Stripe payment in testing, but verified the flow up to and including the Stripe checkout page redirect.
